scope: one observable collision-avoidance change versus existing FBI 10cm policy; final 17cm geometry unchanged
collision_criterion: 2ms solved upward foot support normal z>=.85 allowed on treads; foot riser or side or nonfoot stair contact normal force >0.10N disqualifies the original terminal; separately report raw peak and impulse, no literal zero claim for subthreshold events
curriculum_gate: 12/24 strict original ascent and no collision >0.10 N; refuse promotion on rejected training batch; independent recheck at 17cm
lane0: explicit near-riser net clearance penalty + real contact penalties
lane1: same features and contact penalties, no explicit geometric clearance penalty
